title: Spring Security & Identity
intro: Spring Security interview questions cover the auth layer that protects every modern Java backend — the SecurityFilterChain, authentication providers, password encoding, session vs stateless (JWT) auth, OAuth2 and OpenID Connect, method-level security (@PreAuthorize, @PostAuthorize), CORS and CSRF, and the common pitfalls interviewers love to surface (storing JWTs in localStorage, missing audit fields, leaking principal in logs). This page covers Spring Security with Spring Boot 3, including the modern config-by-bean style and the migration patterns from the older WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter approach.
